_shipping_note: One insured rate per order: the largest piece's rate, plus additional_item for each extra piece.

policies.heading: Shipping
policies.body: Pieces ship within [5 business days] of payment, packed carefully in double-walled boxes and insured. Shipping is currently within the United States only. There is one flat, insured rate per order, based on the largest piece. A tracking number is emailed when your order ships.

policies.heading: Local pickup
policies.body: Pickup is free. After you order, you will get an email with the pickup address and times that work. Please bring the order confirmation.

policies.heading: One of a kind
policies.body: Every piece is handmade and unique. The photos show the exact piece you will receive, and small variations in glaze, color and shape are part of the work. Pieces that look alike are still different, so check the SKU on the order against the one on the piece's page.

policies.heading: Damage and returns
policies.body: If a piece arrives damaged, email within [7 days] with photos of the piece and the packaging and a refund will be arranged. [Decide: whether undamaged pieces can be returned within 14 days for a refund minus shipping.] Because each piece is one of a kind, a replacement is not always possible.

policies.heading: Care
policies.body: [Confirm food safe, dishwasher safe and microwave safe for each type of piece.] Hand wash sculptural and painted work gently, and keep paintings out of direct sun.

_made_note: SKUs: CMT-2018-014 means made in 2018; CMT-ND-014 means no date is known (ND = no date). The page shows 'Made' from the SKU year, or from this made field if you set it (a guess such as c. 2021, or a range).
